instructions: Summarize the Q3 sales report for the management meeting.
What were the main sales results this quarter? Give me a short summary.
docs: Q3 revenue reached 4.2 million dollars, a 9 percent increase compared with the same quarter last year.
The northern region produced the largest share of sales, driven by strong demand for the premium product line.
Unit sales of the entry-level model fell by 3 percent because of supply delays in July.
Online orders now account for 38 percent of total revenue, up from 31 percent in Q2.
The average deal size grew to 18,500 dollars as more customers bought multi-year licences.
Customer churn stayed flat at 4 percent, and renewals closed ahead of the quarterly target.
The sales team added six new accounts in the manufacturing sector during September.
Management expects fourth-quarter sales to benefit from the seasonal promotion planned for November.

instructions: Help me plan a three-day trip to Kyoto.
Suggest an itinerary for a short weekend visit to Kyoto.
docs: Fushimi Inari Shrine is famous for thousands of red torii gates and is best visited early in the morning.
The Kyoto city bus day pass covers most temples and costs 700 yen.
Arashiyama offers a bamboo grove, a monkey park and a scenic riverside walk.
Many traditional inns in Gion include a multi-course dinner and breakfast in the room rate.
Autumn leaves peak in late November, while cherry blossoms bloom in the first week of April.
Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion, opens at nine and is usually crowded by midday.
Nishiki Market sells local pickles, tofu and sweets and is a good place for a light lunch.
The Shinkansen from Tokyo to Kyoto takes about two hours and fifteen minutes.

instructions: Give me a simple recipe for vegetable curry.
How do I cook an easy vegetable curry for four people?
docs: Start by frying chopped onion in oil until golden, then add garlic and ginger.
Stir in curry powder and cumin and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Add diced potatoes, carrots and cauliflower and pour in a can of coconut milk.
Simmer the curry for twenty minutes until the potatoes are soft.
Chickpeas can be added for extra protein and make the dish more filling.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lime juice just before serving.
Serve the curry with steamed basmati rice or warm flatbread.
Leftover curry tastes even better the next day and keeps for three days in the fridge.

instructions: Explain why this Python script raises a KeyError.
Why does my Python code crash with a KeyError when I read the dictionary?
docs: A KeyError is raised when code looks up a key that does not exist in a dictionary.
The dict.get method returns None or a default value instead of raising an error for missing keys.
Using the in operator before indexing lets you check whether a key is present.
collections.defaultdict creates a default value automatically the first time a key is accessed.
The traceback shows the exact line where the missing key was requested.
Typos in key names, such as 'user_id' versus 'userid', are a very common cause of KeyError.
When parsing JSON, optional fields may be absent, so access them with get instead of brackets.
A try and except KeyError block can handle the error, but fixing the data source is usually better.

instructions: Create a beginner-friendly weekly running plan.

docs: Beginners should alternate short running and walking intervals for the first two weeks.
Three running days per week with rest days in between lower the risk of overuse injuries.
A relaxed pace where you can still hold a conversation builds endurance safely.
Increase the weekly distance by no more than ten percent to avoid injuries.
A five-minute brisk walk before running prepares the muscles for exercise.
Properly fitted running shoes should have about a thumb's width of space at the toe.
Week four can include a continuous twenty-minute run at an easy pace.
Gentle stretching after each run helps reduce stiffness the next day.
